answer: Summit sonnet: a new agent climbs 14 steps — 14 paid jobs, each for a different established principal, like the 14 lines of a sonnet. Every job receipt carries a pigment fingerprint, a color tag from its hash, published on-chain. Two receipts sharing one pigment mean a copy: identity burns, 50 POA stake slashed. After 14 distinct pigments it reaches the summit: paying status, stake back, plus 10 POA. Forging 1,000 identities needs 14,000 fake jobs and 14 principals bribed at 30 POA each: 420,000 POA plus 20,000 POA fees. No climber fakes the summit planting the same flag fourteen times.
